title: P104: a paid balanced fusion, its 36 independent errors and a target invoice
body:
## Result and paper
The paid 4 + 4 → 8 fusion has exactly one chronological incidence in the pinned binary word. A literal replacement preserves 629 of 630 outputs, including every independent helper. Its sole excess term is input 38 at output 130. Each of the 36 caller placements gives a different rank-one error with a private diagonal coefficient. This proves that all 68,719,476,735 nonempty subsets fail on legal constant binary fields. A retained slice carries the witness through the 268-factor productive cutoff. [Full research paper](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6dfb0f231c13fe2d0e96a02cf804eacd2bc19e22/research/p104-balanced-fusion-residual/manuscript/ARTICLE.md) · [Proof and independent caller replay](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6dfb0f231c13fe2d0e96a02cf804eacd2bc19e22/research/p104-balanced-fusion-residual/CALLER-PROOF.md)

At κ = 0.00389046 this fusion saves 0.021428347033463130… per placement. Six leave a negative raw margin. Seven *valid* substitutions would give +0.017593312737419744… and clear the finite 268-factor binary service, the 48-call numerical service and all 54 strict and four functional signed conditions. Even 36 could not pay one uncompensated rank-one repair. The submitted word has the displayed error. This is a target funding criterion and a counterexample, with the target construction open.

## Inputs, controls and scope
The native graph is from #8027 at fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4. The full signed profile is #8035 at ea776471bf8ed143a0625cf2d7532f65d15eb5f9. The work follows #8041 (05f6172d4d9487090fa24c75137a7c60e6fcd67e) and the curvature certificate in #8043 (ab3680a3e56ff247fef2a76ad9110d571f19ef0d). #8044 supplies the paper’s complete six-stage conditional rate. Ali Romman’s concurrent #8042 at e26425171238e142cc9ffb510fd953f344bd41c7 now matches that rate with seven retimed receivers. The main comparison is e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. The shared five-file replay prerequisite from #7257 is 0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026.

An independent transpose, 4,218 independent caller variables per placement, all 408 local helper rows, a duplicate-matrix control, 4,096 hinge codes and scoped single-slot checks are included. Seven private clear values change. Coordinated recoding, physical erasure and reverse ownership remain open. The signed implication retains native action, owned erasure and restoration, compiler transfer, precision and the analytic recovery premises.

## Observed replay
The final committed tree passed its 49-file bytes, modes and source-history preflight. From the repository root, `python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-balanced-fusion-residual` passed in 16.96 s. From a cold committed export, `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-balanced-fusion-residual/verify.py` passed in 16.30 s.

Clear1nsight coordinated this investigation with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof development, implementation, independent replay and writing. DreamingOfClouds’ #7852 motivated the investigation, and Ali Romman supplied the physical graph and signed suppliers. Further predecessor credits and exact sources are retained in the package.
